hypothesis: Equal contribution from source-family gradient directions, normalized by training-only per-source gradient norm, improves worst-source heldout accuracy compared with hard minimax source selection under identical 32-update and training-row budgets.

algorithm.control: 32 hard worst-source hinge gradient updates from frozen training examples
algorithm.candidate: At each of 32 updates calculate the 3 per-source hinge gradients from training examples only, normalize each gradient by max(1, its L2 norm), average 3 equally, learning-rate 0.1, zeros initial weights, no heldout feedback
algorithm.evaluation: Blind 48 sealed seeds, 3 source families, paired total and worst-source improvement; no mid-run tuning.

scientific_scope: Synthetic paired-choice source-family robustness only; no external empirical generalization claim

decision_rule.invalidity: No replay; abort on frozen source drift or invalid evidence; failed/ambiguous start consumed.
outcomes: ROBUST_NORMALIZED_GAIN if all 3 blocks strictly pass
PARTIAL_NORMALIZED_GAIN if at least 2 blocks meet +0.02 worst-source gain
